description: Layer 3 (Advanced) deep-dive fixes: Multi-turn chat context, token management, deployment automation, and advanced security hardening.
steps: CHAT-C2: Implement multi-turn conversation context in apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py. In both streaming and non-streaming endpoints, after getting the session_id, load the last N messages from MongoDB (e.g., last 5 turns). Include them in the LLM prompt between the system prompt and the current user message. Use a format like 'Previous conversation:\nUser: ...\nAssistant: ...' Add a token budget of ~2000 chars for history.

CHAT-C3: Implement token/context window management. Create a new utility module apps/backend/app/core/token_budget.py with a function estimate_tokens(text: str) -> int that uses character-based estimation (1 token ~ 4 chars for English, ~2 chars for Assamese). Add a function truncate_to_budget(chunks: list[dict], max_tokens: int) -> list[dict] that truncates context chunks to fit. Use this in chat.py when building system_prompt.

SEC-C3: Add CSRF double-submit pattern for admin endpoints. In apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin.py, generate a CSRF token on admin login and require it as a header (X-CSRF-Token) on all mutating admin requests. Alternatively, set the admin session cookie with SameSite=Strict attribute.

SEC-C4: Implement one-time-use enforcement for password reset tokens. In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py reset_password endpoint, after decoding the token, compute its hash and check Redis for key 'used_reset:{hash}'. If found, reject. After successful reset, store the hash with 1-hour TTL.

AUTH-W3: Fix the refresh endpoint rate limiting to use the shared _check_rate_limit() helper instead of the inline implementation that catches ImportError. Replace the entire try-except block at lines 200-215 with a single call to await _check_rate_limit(request, 'refresh', 10).

AUTH-W4: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py reset_password endpoint, add a check for user.auth_provider. If auth_provider is not 'local', return HTTP 400 'Password reset is not available for OAuth accounts. Please sign in with your OAuth provider.'

DEPLOY-C3: In .github/workflows/deploy-all.yml, replace the 'sleep 90' with a polling loop that checks health every 5 seconds for up to 150 seconds (30 attempts). Use: for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf $URL/health && exit 0; sleep 5; done; exit 1

DEPLOY-C4: In .github/workflows/deploy-all.yml, add a rollback job that triggers when the smoke-test job fails. The rollback job should deactivate the current revision and reactivate the previous one using 'az containerapp revision list' and 'az containerapp update'.

PERF-W4: In apps/backend/app/services/ai/vertex_client.py, add a lock around token refresh to prevent thundering herd. Use asyncio.Lock() to ensure only one coroutine refreshes the token at a time. Cache the access token with its expiry timestamp.

RAG-C2: In apps/backend/app/services/search/azure_search.py, add a fallback for empty tier-filtered results. If the first search returns 0 results, retry without the tier filter and log a warning. Include a flag in the response indicating unfiltered results were used.
acceptance_criteria: Multi-turn chat includes last 5 conversation turns in the LLM prompt
Token budget management truncates context to prevent context window overflow
Admin endpoints have CSRF protection via SameSite=Strict cookies
Password reset tokens are single-use (checked against Redis)
OAuth accounts cannot use password reset flow
Deployment uses health polling instead of fixed sleep
Deployment has automated rollback on smoke test failure
Vertex AI token refresh is protected by asyncio.Lock
Azure Search falls back to unfiltered search when tier filter returns no results
verification: Run: python -c "import ast; [ast.parse(open(f).read()) for f in ['apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py', 'apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py', 'apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin.py', 'apps/backend/app/services/ai/vertex_client.py', 'apps/backend/app/services/search/azure_search.py', 'apps/backend/app/core/token_budget.py']]; print('OK')"
Verify .github/workflows/deploy-all.yml YAML is valid: python -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/deploy-all.yml')); print('YAML valid')"
findings: All 10 acceptance criteria implemented. Tests pass (23 passed, 14 pre-existing errors from missing AZURE_SEARCH_QUERY_KEY in test env - confirmed pre-existing). AST parse and YAML validation both pass.
